notes.title: Update v.03 | November 21, 2023
notes.notes:
First and foremost, I'd like to express my gratitude for your ongoing support and share my plans for the future of the game. Moving forward, I plan to release major updates every 7 days. I'll address bugs as quickly as possible because I don't want anyone to struggle while playing. Therefore, I kindly ask you to join the [url=https://discord.gg/rheUHHyxM5]Discord server[/url] and report any bugs you encounter. Major updates will include new skins, additions, spells for both classes, entirely new features, and more. I plan to release at least one new pistol skin every week. I'm actively seeking out streamers and YouTubers who would be interested in capturing gameplay for the new trailer. In exchange, they would, of course, receive the game for free.
